sentences.en: A tumor of the pituitary gland can cause hypopituitarism.
sentences.zh: 垂体腺肿瘤可能导致垂体功能减退。

sentences.en: The pancreas is a large gland that produces insulin.

sentences.en: Hypophysitis is an inflammation of the pituitary gland.
sentences.zh: 垂体炎是垂体腺的炎症。
